title: Cyber Security Engineering and Risk Management Framework Support Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-CTRS.ACC-APG.W6QK ACC-APG
description_text: The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, and other items and non-personal services necessary to perform Cybersecurity Engineering and DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF) Support Services except for those items specified as government furnished property and services. IT Solutions Architect Sr – must have CISSP certification and minimum 5 years experience managing RMF lifecycle reporting and progressive requirements for network expansion and cloud/enclaves. The other IT Certified Professionals should have Security+ or CASP/SecurityX certification and minimum 3 years experience supporting RMF lifecycle reporting and software/hardware reconciliation. Specifically, the one surge position for Top Secret effort must have minimum 3 years supporting the lifecycle documentation for Top Secret environments. All positions require experience managing across different platforms (Windows/Linux/Apple) and various security classification environments (Unclassified/Classified).
